text:
Rafael: Free curbside pick-up — DXRacer Formula Series gaming chair (black/red) + Dell P2219H 22\" monitor (1080p, IPS). Chair has one slightly torn seam on the left armrest but foam is fine. Monitor has no dead pixels; stand included. Pickup Saturday 11:30–12:30 in SoMa (Brannan & 6th). DM to claim. Pics: https://imgur.com/rgchair
Tori: Ooh i\u2019d take the chair if someone can help me lift it into my hatchback. 11:45 works for me. :pray:
Ben K.: I can help with lifting. Also interested in the monitor if still there. will bring a DP cable.
Rafael: Awesome — Tori you have first dibs on the chair (DMed). Ben, you\u2019re second for the monitor. If both show up, we can split times.
Hannah: Quick Q: does the chair have casters/rolling wheels? I only have stairs at home so would rather carry.
Rafael: Yep casters included. I can remove them if it makes carrying easier.
Tori: Heads up I have a tiny sedan so might need the casters off. Ben, if you don\u2019t mind helping me hoist it in that\u2019d be great.
Ben K.: No prob. I\u2019ll be there ~11:40. Also willing to trade my spare 2m DP cable for the monitor if anyone wants to swap instead of buying new.
Hannah: If the monitor falls through i\u2019d be keen. also happy to trade a USB-C to HDMI adapter for the DP cable.
Rafael: Gate code for building lobby: `0952`. Leave by the loading bay and i\u2019ll stick a note. If multiple DMs i\u2019ll go by arrival order.
Tori: DM sent with my phone #. Thanks raf! :heart:
Ben K.: DMed too. Bringing a blanket to protect the chair during transit.
Rafael: Update 11:58am — Chair claimed by Tori (picked up). Monitor is still available; Ben you\u2019re up next. Leaving monitor on the bench by bay 2 with a sticky note.
Ben K.: Picked up the monitor. Thanks for the cable trade offer — Hannah i\u2019ll ping you about the adapter.
Hannah: Cool, thanks Ben! If anything else pops up i\u2019ll take it off your hands :grin:
